articles.title: Storm Rachel Gets Weaker but Brings More Rain
articles.summary: Storm Rachel flooded parts of Southern California and set a rain record in Las Vegas, and more storms may come this winter.

articles.title: Trump Says Russia and Ukraine Will Stop Attacking Power Plants
articles.summary: President Trump said Russia and Ukraine agreed to stop attacking energy sites, but Ukraine said attacks continued.

articles.title: Police Worry About New Limits on Chinese Drones
articles.summary: The U.S. is limiting drones made in China, but many police departments use them and say American drones cost more.
